task: Turn this into a task list with owners and dates for the finance team.
text:
Subject: Audit fieldwork, documents for next week

Hi team, our external auditor, Mei-Ling Tan, has sent the first request list for the year-end audit. Fieldwork starts on 9 February and she wants the fixed asset register, the bank reconciliations for months 10 to 12 and a sample of 25 purchase invoices by 4 February. Our controller, Henrik Dahl, will review everything first, so upload to the shared folder by 2 February, not 4 February. If Mei-Ling queries a sample item, call her on 020 7946 0551 rather than replying by email. The audit job reference is AUD-24-0816 and you can send the final pack to m.tan@auditors.example.com.

Subject: Audit fieldwork, documents for next week

Hi team, our external auditor, [PERSON_1], has sent the first request list for the year-end audit. Fieldwork starts on 9 February and she wants the fixed asset register, the bank reconciliations for months 10 to 12 and a sample of 25 purchase invoices by 4 February. Our controller, [PERSON_2], will review everything first, so upload to the shared folder by 2 February, not 4 February. If [PERSON_1] queries a sample item, call her on [PHONE] rather than replying by email. The audit job reference is [ACCOUNT_ID] and you can send the final pack to [EMAIL].

review.notes: BLOCKING FACT_COMPLETENESS (ruling 24): the condition word 'If' is outside every required quote. The source is 'If Mei-Ling queries a sample item, call her on 020 7946 0551 rather than replying by email.' but the required fragments are 'queries a sample item, call her on' and 'rather than replying by email.', so with the alias the claim reads '[PERSON_1] queries a sample item, call her on' with no conditional. The author note says the 'If' is kept by that fragment, which is wrong (the fragment starts after 'If Mei-Ling'). The task asks for owners and dates, and this call-rather-than-email instruction is a listed dependency. Minimal repair: add a required fragment 'If' (occurrence 3 or whichever resolves to the 'If ' before 'Mei-Ling queries'), or extend it to start at 'If'. Everything else checked out (aliases stable for 'Mei-Ling Tan'/'Mei-Ling'; 'upload ... by 2 February, not 4 February' correction covered). NOTE: audit job reference tagged ACCOUNT_ID PLACEHOLDER is acceptable under ruling 13.
